title: Contiguity, Not Importance: Budgeted Repair of Stale KV Caches After Document Edits
abstract: arXiv:2609.17983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV-cache reuse can reduce inference cost in retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems, but cached contexts may become stale when retrieved knowledge, working memory, or user state is edited. Under causal self-attention, even a local edit can affect downstream KV states. A full re-prefill reliably restores consistency but is costly, whereas refreshing only the edited span can leave downstream dependencies stale. We formulate in-place repair as budgeted recomputation and compare training-free position-selection policies on a factual RAG benchmark with matched direct and derived edits. Across three model families, all policies repair direct cases, but derived cases clearly separate them. At the primary budget, a contiguous edit-local window recovers at least 0.94 of the post-edit answer margin and substantially outperforms attention-based, KV-deviation, and structural selectors. translated_title: 连续性而非重要性：文档编辑后陈旧KV缓存的预算化修复
translated_abstract: KV缓存复用可以降低检索增强生成和智能体系统中的推理成本，但当检索到的知识、工作记忆或用户状态被编辑时，缓存的上下文可能会变得陈旧。在因果自注意力机制下，即使是局部编辑也会影响下游的KV状态。完整的重新预填充能可靠地恢复一致性，但代价高昂；而仅刷新被编辑的片段又可能使下游依赖保持陈旧状态。我们将原位修复形式化为预算化重计算问题，并在一个包含匹配的直接编辑和派生编辑的事实性RAG基准上比较了多种无需训练的位置选择策略。在三个模型家族上的实验表明，所有策略都能修复直接编辑的情况，但在派生编辑的情况上表现明显分化。在主要预算下，连续的编辑局部窗口能够恢复至少0.94的编辑后答案边际，并显著优于基于注意力、KV偏差和结构的选择器。机制分析表明，有效的位置集合……
tldr: 该研究发现，文档编辑后修复陈旧KV缓存时，采用连续的编辑局部窗口进行预算化重计算，效果显著优于基于注意力、KV偏差和结构性等重要性的位置选择策略，能恢复至少94%的编辑后答案性能。
en_tdlr: A contiguous edit-local window for budgeted KV-cache recomputation substantially outperforms importance-based selection policies (attention-based, KV-deviation, and structural) in repairing stale caches after document edits, recovering at least 0.94 of the post-edit answer margin.
